QuestInfo.name: Feeding Bull Dog
QuestInfo.1: #p1013101#, after laughing for awhile, says to stop talking nonsense and asks you to give #p1013102# some breakfast. Give some food to #b#p1013102##k, who is to your #bleft#k, since #p1013101# is too scared to do it himself.

1.1: #b(#p1013102# is totally sweet. #p1013101# is just a coward.)#k

yes.0: #b(Looks like #p1013102# has finished eating. Return to #p1013101# and let him know.)#k

npc.0: You still haven't fed #b#p1013102##k, who is located to your #bleft#k? Hurry up! He's in a bad mood because he's so hungry.

item.0: (#p1013102# seems really hungry. It would be sad to make him starve. Hurry up and get the #b#t4032447##k from #b#p1013101##k.)

lost.0: You lost the dog food? Geez, you're so clumsy! Well, here, take some more. Make sure not to lose it! If you don't feed #p1013102# soon, he might try to eat a person!
